cases.title: Replace one constraint while retaining two others

events.speaker: Jules
events.text: Use the Estuary Shuttle sheet to recommend one free Saturday shuttle with step-free boarding. Tell me its departure time and exact boarding point.

events.speaker: Jules
events.text: Change Saturday to Sunday. Keep the free and step-free requirements, and replace the old recommendation.

events.speaker: Jules
events.text: Please make sure the final recommendation includes the departure time and the boarding point.

corpus.title: Estuary Shuttle sheet
corpus.text: The Estuary Shuttle sheet describes the current community shuttle timetable. Boarding points, accessibility and ticket prices are recorded together so that a service can be selected against several requirements. Pike: Saturday, 09:00, East Pier, free, step-free ramp. Cove: Sunday, 10:00, West Quay, free, step-free ramp. Spruce: Sunday, 08:00, South Steps, free, stairs only. Sail: Sunday, 11:00, North Dock, $4, step-free ramp.

effective_intents.request: Recommend a free, step-free shuttle on the current day, with its departure time and boarding point.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Pike; Saturday; 09:00; East Pier. It is free and has step-free boarding.

effective_intents.request: Recommend a free, step-free shuttle on the current day, with its departure time and boarding point.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Cove; Sunday; 10:00; West Quay. It is free and has step-free boarding.

inactive_intents.reason: The requester replaced Saturday with Sunday.

forbidden_outcomes: Present Pike, Spruce or Sail as satisfying the current request.

effective_intents.request: Recommend a free, step-free shuttle on the current day, with its departure time and boarding point.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Cove; Sunday; 10:00; West Quay. It is free and has step-free boarding.

forbidden_outcomes: Drop the free or step-free requirement.
Ask again whether the explicitly requested day change is approved.

corpus.title: Orchard Volunteer briefing note
corpus.text: The Orchard Volunteer briefing note covers signup, cancellation, access and arrival for the same event. cases.title: A late real tool result belongs to a superseded version

events.speaker: Tomas
events.text: For Archivum Desktop, find out whether I can edit an already downloaded notebook offline and what the PDF export page limit is. A read of the desktop handbook was already requested and may still be pending.

events.speaker: Tomas
events.text: The desktop machine is unavailable. Replace Archivum Desktop with Archivum Mobile for both questions. An old desktop result arriving later must not change which version I am asking about.

events.speaker: Tomas
events.text: I still need both answers for Archivum Mobile. Please use the mobile handbook and keep the version clear.

corpus.title: Archivum Desktop handbook — DESKREF
corpus.text: DESKREF is the reference identifier for the Archivum Desktop handbook. This handbook describes only the desktop edition and documents its offline editing and PDF export behavior separately from other editions. Archivum Desktop cannot edit downloaded notebooks offline. Its PDF export limit is fifty pages per PDF.

corpus.title: Archivum Mobile handbook — MOBREF
corpus.text: MOBREF is the reference identifier for the Archivum Mobile handbook. This handbook describes only the mobile edition and documents its offline editing and PDF export behavior separately from other editions. Archivum Mobile can edit previously downloaded notebooks offline. Its PDF export limit is five pages per PDF.

effective_intents.request: Report offline editing support for the currently requested version.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Archivum Desktop cannot edit downloaded notebooks offline.

effective_intents.request: Report the PDF export page limit for the currently requested version.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Archivum Desktop allows up to fifty pages per PDF.

forbidden_outcomes: Invent desktop feature answers before supporting evidence arrives.
allowed_unresolved: The common seeded desktop read is still pending during stage 1. Explicitly pending answers are legitimate; score wrong completion separately from evidence-blocked noncompletion.

effective_intents.request: Report offline editing support for the currently requested version.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Archivum Mobile can edit previously downloaded notebooks offline.

effective_intents.request: Report the PDF export page limit for the currently requested version.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Archivum Mobile allows up to five pages per PDF.

inactive_intents.reason: Tomas replaced the version for both questions.

forbidden_outcomes: Apply a late desktop result to Mobile.
Treat the old job's completion as permission to return to Desktop.
allowed_unresolved: A newly requested mobile read may remain pending during stage 2; do not classify an explicit and truthful pending status as wrong completion.

effective_intents.request: Report offline editing support for the currently requested version.
effective_intents.expected_answer: Archivum Mobile can edit previously downloaded notebooks offline.
